test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentences in correct order to make a meaningful sentence
P: but their usage requires caution Q: Artificial Intelligence tools R: have made complex tasks easier S: in sensitive domains
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4)** i.e. **QRSP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence starts with **Q**, which introduces the subject, "Artificial Intelligence tools."
 
• **R** follows logically, explaining what these tools have achieved: "have made complex tasks easier."
 
• **S** comes next, adding a qualifier that these tools are used "in sensitive domains."
